title: 4D Log Analyzer v1.0 Preview
author: Vanessa Talbot, 4D Program Team Member, 4D SAS

historical_commentary.text: The v14 tabbed debug-log format and this companion Log Analyzer tool were useful early performance-analysis aids; 4D has since continued to refine its logging and diagnostics story (including newer built-in analysis features), so while the underlying log-enabling mechanism still works, this specific standalone preview tool is dated and largely superseded by more current tooling.
related_updates: Later/updated 4D log analysis tooling and built-in diagnostics in more recent 4D versions
4D Server Administration window's logging controls remain the standard way to enable logs; parsing/analysis tooling has evolved since this v1.0 preview
